name: I Do One Push-Up
aka: Every Time I Do One Push-Up
look: A four-panel comic in a 2x2 grid. A small guy with bushy orange hair and a yellow T-shirt asks a huge, muscular white figure with a tiny smiling face how he got like that. The buff figure says "Every time...", then "...I do one push-up", and the small guy answers "Jesus Christ."
text: WOW! HOW DID YOU GET LIKE THAT?
use: The buff character explains that he does one push-up every time a certain thing happens. The joke is that the event is so frequent, annoying or relatable that it has made him enormous.
slots: the very frequent event, after "every time" (top right speech bubble)
examples: someone in a meeting says "let's circle back"
my phone warns me my storage is almost full
describe: super buff white guy says he does one push up every time
comic of a muscular blob man and an orange haired guy
huge muscle man explaining his workout in a four panel comic
jacked cartoon man with a tiny smiling face
guy got huge from something that happens all the time
